move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
early_prediction: Panel is genuinely split and weak (consensus -8, range -25 to +12, 5 of 7 negative but none beyond Lean-Down strength) on a live guidance binary -- the June sales-guide cut already reset the bar once, and whether a second cut is needed is the swing question; likely a modest, ambiguous move rather than a repeat of the two double-digit historical prints; main caveat is two-sided squeeze/breakdown risk from a rebuilt-but-loose short base plus a large Class B sponsor overhang that could sell into any relief rally.
red_team_survival_note: The red-team case (Q2 gross margin pre-guided down, consensus revenue at the top of management's own range, no squeeze mechanic in the float) landed at only -8, near the panel's weakest score, and was matched almost exactly by the base-rate persona's independent -9 -- but two personas (macro/peer read-through +10, forensics +12) read the same setup as a bar already reset by June's cut, pointing to strong peer prints (Petco, Freshpet) and management's own buyback-funded buying as reasons the skeptic case may be stale. The thesis did not survive unanimously: it is contested territory, not a dominant view, which is why the panel lands at No Edge rather than Lean Down.
